## Upload — R to GCS and BigQuery

`upload_international_results.R` in the **world_cup_analytics** repo:

1. `gcs_upload()` — dated prefix under `raw/international/results/`
2. `read_csv()` with explicit types (`NA` scores → NULL)
3. `bq_table_upload()` — `WRITE_TRUNCATE` into `analytics.international_results`

::: {.notes}
Run this in RStudio/console for 10–20 seconds if you want; do not depend on it for the Shiny demo.
:::

---

## Upload script (placeholder)

```r
# TODO: trim to 8–12 lines for the slide
gcs_upload(local_csv, name = gcs_object)
results <- read_csv(local_csv, col_types = cols(...))
bq_table_upload(
  bq_table(project_id, "analytics", "international_results"),
  results,
  write_disposition = "WRITE_TRUNCATE"
)
```

## Why the live demo stays on CSV

| Concern | CSV bundled in repo | BigQuery at session start |
|---------|----------------------|---------------------------|
| Auth / network | Works offline | SA JSON, IAM, billing |
| Tables | All tabs covered | Only results in BQ today |
| Posit Connect | Ship `data/international/` | Secrets + BQ access |
| Latency | Instant filters | Download on every deploy |

**Verdict for this talk:** CSV in the app; BQ in the pipeline story.

## Deploy — Posit Connect Cloud

Same pattern as other course apps:

1. `rsconnect::writeManifest()` next to `app.R`
2. Push `app.R`, `manifest.json`, **`data/international/`**
3. Connect restores packages from `manifest.json`
